name: OmneSuite-All-in-one AI generator for images, video, music, voice, and text
tagline: OmneSuite is an all-in-one AI tools platform built for fast content creation across multiple formats
description: OmneSuite is an all-in-one AI tools platform built for fast content creation across multiple formats. Users can generate images, video scripts, music, lyrics, voice, text, and other creative assets from simple prompts, all in one place. The platform currently offers 26 AI tools spanning image generation, video generation, music generation, voice generation, text generation, and creative tools like meme, quiz, and emoji generators. New users can register to get 20 free credits with 7-day validity
